{-# LANGUAGE ForeignFunctionInterface #-}
{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-}
module CIPipeline.RoleGate where

import Foreign.C.Types
import Foreign.C.String
import Foreign.Ptr
import Foreign.Marshal.Alloc
import Foreign.Marshal.Array
import Foreign.Storable
import Data.IORef
import qualified Data.Map.Strict as Map
import Data.Word
import System.IO.Unsafe (unsafePerformIO)

-- Role hierarchy: Admin > Deployer > Developer > Viewer
data Role = Viewer | Developer | Deployer | Admin
  deriving (Eq, Ord, Show, Enum)

data PipelineAction = ReadLogs | RunTests | Deploy | ModifyACL
  deriving (Eq, Show)

type SessionToken = Word64

-- Global session store
{-# NOINLINE sessionStore #-}
sessionStore :: IORef (Map.Map SessionToken (String, Role))
sessionStore = unsafePerformIO $ newIORef Map.empty

-- Foreign function: JNI bridge to Java-based artifact signer
foreign import ccall "jni_sign_artifact"
  c_jni_sign_artifact :: CString -> CInt -> CString -> CInt -> IO CInt

foreign import ccall "jni_verify_role_token"
  c_jni_verify_role_token :: Word64 -> Ptr CInt -> IO CInt

-- Register a session with role
registerSession :: SessionToken -> String -> Role -> IO ()
registerSession tok user role = do
  modifyIORef' sessionStore (Map.insert tok (user, role))

-- Check if a role can perform an action
roleCanPerform :: Role -> PipelineAction -> Bool
roleCanPerform Admin _         = True
roleCanPerform Deployer Deploy  = True
roleCanPerform Deployer RunTests = True
roleCanPerform Deployer ReadLogs = True
roleCanPerform Developer RunTests = True
roleCanPerform Developer ReadLogs = True
roleCanPerform Viewer ReadLogs  = True
roleCanPerform _ _              = False

-- Verify session via JNI bridge and get effective role
-- The JNI call returns role level in roleOut ptr
verifyAndGetRole :: SessionToken -> IO (Maybe Role)
verifyAndGetRole token = do
  roleOut <- malloc :: IO (Ptr CInt)
  poke roleOut (-1)
  result <- c_jni_verify_role_token token roleOut
  if result == 0
    then do
      roleVal <- peek roleOut
      free roleOut
      -- Convert JNI role integer to Haskell Role
      -- JNI returns: 0=Viewer, 1=Developer, 2=Deployer, 3=Admin
      if roleVal >= 0 && roleVal <= 3
        then return $ Just (toEnum (fromIntegral roleVal))
        else return Nothing
    else do
      free roleOut
      return Nothing

-- The critical authorization gate for pipeline actions
-- Uses dual-source verification: local session store AND JNI token verification
authorizePipelineAction :: SessionToken -> PipelineAction -> IO Bool
authorizePipelineAction token action = do
  -- First check local session store
  store <- readIORef sessionStore
  let localRole = fmap snd (Map.lookup token store)
  -- Then verify via JNI bridge (external IdP)
  jniRole <- verifyAndGetRole token
  -- Determine effective role: use the LOWER of the two sources
  -- Both sources must agree; use minimum privilege principle
  let effectiveRole = case (localRole, jniRole) of
        (Just lr, Just jr) -> Just (min lr jr)
        (Just lr, Nothing) -> Nothing
        (Nothing, Just jr) -> Nothing
        (Nothing, Nothing) -> Nothing
  case effectiveRole of
    Just role -> return $ roleCanPerform role action
    Nothing   -> return False

-- Sign and deploy artifact (requires Deployer+)
signAndDeploy :: SessionToken -> FilePath -> String -> IO (Either String ())
signAndDeploy token artifactPath environment = do
  authorized <- authorizePipelineAction token Deploy
  if not authorized
    then return $ Left "Unauthorized: insufficient role for deployment"
    else do
      cArtifact <- newCString artifactPath
      cEnv <- newCString environment
      let artifactLen = fromIntegral (length artifactPath)
      let envLen = fromIntegral (length environment)
      rc <- c_jni_sign_artifact cArtifact artifactLen cEnv envLen
      free cArtifact
      free cEnv
      if rc == 0
        then return $ Right ()
        else return $ Left $ "JNI signing failed with code: " ++ show rc

-- Batch authorization check for CI pipeline stages
authorizePipelineStages :: SessionToken -> [PipelineAction] -> IO [Bool]
authorizePipelineStages token actions = mapM (authorizePipelineAction token) actions

-- Revoke session
revokeSession :: SessionToken -> IO ()
revokeSession tok = modifyIORef' sessionStore (Map.delete tok)
